given.note: S1-75: Lee's Barbershop's listing has an email, so the control code goes there (Q-02). The code proves the business, not a person, so it names none (forPersonId null: a listing_control code, K-22 v1 proof_codes_who); the listing email's handle is where the code row says it went. The code never comes back to the caller and never reaches the event log.
